description: This file contains controller functions for managing client data in a Node.js application using Express and Mongoose. It includes functions for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting client records, as well as fetching clients by user ID.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Fetches a single client by ID from the database.

methods.name: getClients
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of clients, sorted by ID in descending order.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a new client record with the provided data.

methods.name: updateClient
methods.description: Updates an existing client record identified by ID.

methods.name: deleteClient
methods.description: Deletes a client record by ID.

methods.name: getClientsByUser
methods.description: Fetches clients associated with a specific user ID.
